description: Fix a std::priority_queue that compares by priority alone (no FIFO guarantee for ties) into an insertion-order-stable one
prompts: stable_priority_queue.h wraps std::priority_queue<Item> with a comparator that only compares Item::priority - std::priority_queue makes NO ordering guarantee among elements the comparator treats as equal (it's a binary heap, not a stable structure). Fix it so that: (1) items with a lower priority number come out first, and (2) items with EQUAL priority always come out in the order they were originally pushed (FIFO) - add an explicit monotonically increasing insertion-order field to Item and use it as the comparator's tiebreaker (remember std::priority_queue is a MAX-heap by default, so the comparator needs the right sense to get min-priority-first, FIFO-tiebreak pop order).
name: add_cpp_stable_priority_queue
